{
  "question_intent": "Understanding business focus and leverage in Equity Derivatives and Financing",
  "main_topics": ["Equity Derivatives", "Financing", "Leverage", "Market Position", "Business Segmentation"],
  "answer_completeness": "Complete",
  "response_stance": "Direct",
  "evidence_level": "High",
  "contains_numeric_evidence": true,
  "contains_forward_guidance": false,
  "narrative_alignment": "Aligned",
  "question_quote": "The first question, just coming back to Equity Derivatives in Asia, you mentioned, you don't have a retail business, but if I look at the largest players, they don't have a retail business either. These are the Americans who control the market. So, I'm just trying to understand, your position compared to your peer group really, which is mainly doing Chinese corporate offshore/onshore derivative business. That's where the money is rather than retail. Just want to understand what business do you think you're not doing, which leads to a weaker position.",
  "answer_quote": "Okay, let me start, and I might ask Dan to add to the leverage part of the question. On Equity Derivatives, we feel like there were comments out there in the market around Retail and Wealth, that was our broader understanding. Some of them do have Retail and Wealth businesses, so that's clearly helped their businesses. For us, I'll go back to what I said before, don't expect us to have a significant Asian Equities business. Equity Derivatives is one of the focus areas that we called out right at the beginning of the plan. An area where we felt we really wanted to build capability. It's one where we've monetised the market well, when there's been volatility, less so when there hasn't. And that's clearly something we are reflective of Kian, and an area that we, clearly given the Q3 results, need to keep working on. So that's how I'd characterise it.",
  "reason": "The response directly addresses the question's intent, provides a high level of evidence with specific references to market conditions and business strategy, and aligns with the narrative of the question."
}
